hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '\.dart$'; then dart format "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '\.go$'; then gofmt -w "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '\.go$'; then cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && go vet ./... 2>&1 | head -20; fi
echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'flutter clean|pub cache repair' && echo 'Warning: this clears build cache, will be slow' >&2; exit 0
